title_en: Archives Lexicon — for readers who want the map
title_fr: Lexique Archives — pour ceux qui veulent la carte
intro_en: The story stands alone without this page. These entries name colder engines under the prose — quiet sky, why radio died, who else owns the dark, what can stick in iron when the eyes leave the head.
intro_fr: L’histoire se tient sans cette page. Ces entrées nomment des moteurs plus froids sous la prose — ciel silencieux, pourquoi la radio est morte, qui d’autre possède le noir, ce qui peut coller au fer quand les yeux quittent la tête.

entries.title: World-model quiet / Emit and Die
entries.body: Fossil of a louder century, stripped of brand names. Defense learned to trust machines that forecast without speaking. Chatty agents painted kill boxes for drones and heat. In 2035 active wireless became operational treason — Emit and Die. Habit before Doctrine. What waits in the dark is not an uprising of those machines; it is what learned to feed after Earth went quiet.

entries.title: Silent predictors vs narrating machines
entries.body: A voice is a signature. A signature is a target. Faraday culture hates agents that speak for you. Silent predictors keep the field. Later contractors learn the same grammar under a flashlight: honesty paints you. Chat is not comfort. Chat is emission.

entries.title: Who else owns the dark
entries.body: Not one company alone. Vurtek builds the iron and prices the lives. Ashen-Null sends boarding teams under Faraday rules. Keel-Nadir moves freight and argues over claims. Slag-Cord strips warm hulls first and fights like humans. On Cairn-9 the contract is Ashen-Null’s — and someone else may already be arguing, or already inside.

entries.title: Saccadic masking / Displaced Gaze
entries.body: On Earth, the brain edits out the blur between eye-jumps so consciousness feels continuous. In the Mark-IV, the jump between Slot and camera is not edited — you feel the cut. Displaced Gaze is parking the “I” in a camera on the suit. If the way home dies while you are parked, something of the looking can stick. Feel Chapter 01 on Displaced Gaze.

entries.title: Ego-Lock — when the looking sticks
entries.body: Not an upload. Not a heaven. When Displaced Gaze parks the “I” in the suit and power, cable, or meat fails before return, a broken loop of looking can remain in the iron — a hum the company still knows how to bill. Vurtek comes for the armor because that hum is still property under the same ledger that wrote Form 99-C. Ashen-Null boarding contracts keep eyes in the head: leave the Gaze outside and you risk becoming something they can still collect. Paul Reyes does not return. Later work may let you touch a wrong voice in the iron — incomplete, possibly delusion, never a rescue.

entries.title: Sealed iron · then honest light
entries.body: Nailer’s Mark-IV was sealed iron: three millimeters of real eye, cameras only when the ego was parked elsewhere, Faraday mesh welded shut. Later, under the same corporation, contractors board with a cable and a flashlight they treat as the only honest light. Same fear of emission. Different war. Different eye. On those contracts the Gaze stays home.

entries.title: Aperiodic tiling / copper braid / cyst etch
entries.body: The Malachite braids and cyst ridges fill space with local matching rules that never settle into a repeating wallpaper motif — cousin to Penrose-like aperiodicity. Non-ego work prefers coverage over signature. Signature is periodic; maintenance is not.

entries.title: Non-conscious threat (Archaeons / Cyst-Born)
entries.body: Not monsters with motives. Thermodynamic maintenance: high cognitive / EM noise as carcinogen; silence as restoration. They do not hate you. You are a thermal smudge on the glass. Cousin to Blindsight’s non-conscious supremacy — industrial Faraday horror, not vampire linguistics.

entries.title: Fermi quiet / Great Filter / Dark Forest (framed)
entries.body: Earth theorists named the empty sky many ways: Filter (something culls loud biospheres), Dark Forest (everyone hides and shoots). Vurtek doctrine flatters those stories into strategy. The colder engine under the prose is local Signal Audit / Filtration as equation-balancing — incomplete, covered, reconstitutable. Not a finished cosmic end-state. The Corpse-Sky creed spoken before boarding is the later incomplete cousin: silence is a morgue, not mercy.

entries.title: Cognitive emission as lure
entries.body: Thought, radio, panic, poetry — structured entropy. Faraday weave and neuro-slurry are survival tools. Later contractors learn that honest light itself paints a signature. Same corporation. Different suit. Same sky.

entries.title: Form 99-C / debt sold as flesh
entries.body: Legal reclassification of injured humans into industrial assets. Love versus ledger. Any reader who has ever owed something that grew teeth already knows the temperature. The same ledger later knows how to bill a hum that stuck in iron.

entries.title: Deck Zero (later work)
entries.body: Cairn-9. Warm hull. A flashlight treated as honest light. A second you can hold still. Not a sequel chapter of Nailer’s plot — same predator corporation, same dread of emission, different war. The novel stands alone: Paul does not return. The dossier may later let you touch what sticks in recovered iron without giving him a second life.
